findings.title: Design claim is retrospective prose, not measured in-diff
findings.detail: The design.archetype 'Metric board' and anti-column justification cite external PNGs and design_audit.mjs output (evidence/design-dashboard.json) that are not added or changed in this diff. A claim that evidence was opened cannot be verified from the unified diff; FAIL closed on the measurement assertion.

findings.title: coverage-state baseCommit bump without proof
findings.detail: baseCommit moved to 97aa587... with highWaterPct still 91.66. Diff does not show how that commit was validated or that coverage still meets the water mark; status-only metadata change.

findings.title: RunDetailView extraction is testable
findings.detail: RunDetailView is exported with injectable slug/state; RunDetail still wires useParams/useRuns/useDocumentMeta and renders the view. Tests for loading/error/missing-slug/not-found appear in the truncated portion — structure of the refactor is sound for unit testing.

findings.title: Favicon re-derive script alone does not prove assets shipped
findings.detail: Script resizes logo-mark.png to favicon-96.png and apple-180.png with transparent background. Diff snippet does not include binary public/ asset changes; cannot verify favicon legibility improvement from the script alone.

findings.title: Prior-art docs present in diff
findings.detail: COMPETITORS.md and SOURCES.md are new and non-empty with structure, gaps, and citations. Existence of prior-art files is verified in-diff; factual accuracy of external URLs is not re-checked here.
